4. CONCLUSION

A review of earthquake information for a region within about 350 km of Hong Kong
has been carried out. Where possible, earthquake magnitudes have been re-calculated. The
difference between the re-calculated magnitudes and those given in previous publications is
generally not greater than % for earthquakes with macroseismic data and 0.3 for those with
instrumental data. The earthquake magnitudes given in Table 2 may be used with greater
confidence for any subsequent assessment of seismic risk in Hong Kong.
